value.body: A travel consultant helps customers decide where to go and puts the trip together — flights, hotels, transfers, sightseeing, visas and insurance — then sells it as a package. Employers are travel agencies, tour operators and online travel companies. The job is part planning, part sales, and many roles carry monthly sales targets.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: Ticketing and destination training are common add-ons

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Booking portals, GDS, CRM software, messaging apps

items.label: Pay structure
items.value: Fixed pay plus sales incentives in many firms

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join travel agencies, tour operators or online travel companies as sales or reservation trainees. Internships with travel firms during the degree and a short ticketing course help with a first offer.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior consultant, product or destination specialist, branch manager.
Peak holiday seasons mean long hours and weekend work.
Income can depend on sales incentives, so it varies month to month.
